name: SSH Brute Force Attack
short_description: Use Hydra to crack weak SSH passwords.
description: Many systems still use weak or default passwords. This lesson teaches you to use Hydra to brute force SSH credentials. The target has an intentionally weak password: root/root.

steps.title: Verify SSH is running
steps.explanation: Confirm the SSH service is accessible.

steps.title: Create a small wordlist
steps.explanation: For speed, we'll use a tiny wordlist. Real attacks use larger lists like rockyou.txt.

steps.title: Run Hydra brute force
steps.explanation: Hydra tries each password. -l root targets the root user. -t 4 means 4 parallel threads.

steps.title: Accept host key
steps.explanation: Type 'yes' to accept the SSH host key (first connection only).

steps.title: Enter password
steps.explanation: Type the password we found: root. (No prompt - just type!)

steps.title: Verify root access
steps.explanation: Confirm you have root access on the target.

success_criteria: You're logged in as root@vulnssh with a # prompt.
